# crosswork_te_general_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the general settings of traffic engineering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_te_general_settings" "example" {
  policy_unused_threshold                  = 2000
  policy_provisioning_timeout              = 120
  bandwidth_on_demand_provisioning_timeout = 100
  igp_path_request_timeout                 = 200
  policy_details_request_timeout           = 220
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bandwidth_on_demand_provisioning_timeout` (Number) Bandwidth on demand policy provisioning timeout in seconds
  - Range: `60`-`900`
  - Default value: `90`
- `igp_path_request_timeout` (Number) IGP path request timeout in seconds
  - Range: `60`-`900`
  - Default value: `180`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `policy_details_request_timeout` (Number) Policy and tunnel details request timeout in seconds
  - Range: `60`-`900`
  - Default value: `180`
- `policy_provisioning_timeout` (Number) Policy and tunnel provisioning timeout in seconds
  - Range: `60`-`900`
  - Default value: `60`
- `policy_unused_threshold` (Number) Policy unused threshold in kbps
  - Range: `0`-`5000`
  - Default value: `1000`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_te_general_settings.example "te_general_settings"
```
